current_logic: Cross-sectional CatBoost+Linear hybrid ranker with triple-barrier labels, independent model diversity, IC-weighted ensemble with LSO validation. Short signals via 1-alpha_long fallback. Linear baseline (IC-weighted) emerging as more robust than CatBoost for low-SNR crypto CS alpha.

architecture.core_model: CatBoost YetiRank (9 slots/direction) + IC-weighted Linear baseline (3 slots/direction)
architecture.diversity_mechanism: 3 independent CatBoost models per theme (subsample/rsm/seed variation), eliminating staged-checkpoint fake breadth (A1)
architecture.label_generation: Triple-barrier method: TP=1.0 / SL=0.0 / time-elapsed=0.5, with cross-sectional market-neutral demeaning (B1+B2)
architecture.ensemble: IC²-weighted blend of surviving slots (current: 2 linear baselines, 0 CatBoost)
architecture.short_strategy: 1.0 - alpha_long (single CS ranker inverted), automatic fallback when no separate short slots survive

critical_findings.catboost_vs_linear: With triple-barrier labels + Newey-West SE, linear IC-weighted baselines (A2) survive DSR gate (OOS-IC 0.026-0.050) while all 9 CatBoost slots fail DSR. Root cause: discrete 3-value labels {0, 0.5, 1} poorly suited to YetiRank pairwise optimization; neutral label 0.5 creates uninformative pairs. Implication: nonlinear GB trees may be overfit instrument for overlapping low-SNR alpha signals. Recommendation: (1) tune barrier to reduce neutral%, (2) switch to RMSE loss, or (3) commit to linear factor blending as primary engine.
critical_findings.short_model_failure: Separate short CatBoostRanker consistently produced CSIC-OOS sign-flip: IS IC positive but OOS CSIC negative. A3 replacement (1-alpha_long) eliminates redundancy, saves 80% training time. Fallback works correctly.
critical_findings.independent_diversity_success: A1 change (staged checkpoints → 3 independent models/theme with subsample/rsm variation) improved IC Retention 67%→72%, confirming staged predictions were mathematically correlated ~0.85-0.95. Effective breadth now honest (~6-9) vs claimed 24.
critical_findings.newey_west_effect: Enabling Newey-West for overlapping 6-bar labels increased SE, reduced t-stats. Converted false DSR passes to failures. Indicates label inflation was real. IC Retention increased 72%→83.8% (fewer false survivors), but eliminated CatBoost slots entirely.
